No other moving traffic is present near the crossing.

actions.description: The ego vehicle drives forward along the urban street at cruising speed, approaching the marked pedestrian crossing with no traffic nearby. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

A person on a low electric mobility scooter rolls quickly off the right curb and begins crossing in front of the ego vehicle. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The scooter moves rapidly across the crossing while the ego vehicle continues at its normal cruising speed without slowing or stopping. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

By 0:02 the crossing fills the mid-foreground as the vehicle maintains its speed. From 0:03 to 0:05 the scooter moves rapidly across the crossing directly in the vehicle's path, yet the ego vehicle continues at its normal cruising speed without slowing or stopping, closing the gap to the crossing.
